items.body_excerpt:
I enjoy/respect Zach Lowe & Kirk Goldsberry but I can’t believe they are giving Giannis Antetokounmpo a pass on having no pressure in his first season in Miami.

The whole reason he wanted out was to chase a championship. 

Every national pundit wanted him out so he could do so. (1/3)
